prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes (won): Reordering sign-in after adoption, a new home flow, targeted hints (adoption, path decision, sign-in security), and a path selection layout update significantly improved metrics.
Harmful changes (worse): Streamlined path selection copy (-4.7%) and an account persistence sign-in hint (-5.8%) significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, wait time info, incentives, and most copy changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Expected gains were generally overestimated across most tests, including large predicted gains like +15.0% and +14.0%.
Predictions too low: Predictions underestimated gains for multiple winning tests, including the home new flow (+1.0% vs +8.6%), path decision hint (+0.5% vs +3.1%), sign-in security hint (-4.0% vs +3.1%), and card carousel layout (+0.8% vs +5.3%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, incentive: +0.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: +2.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -4.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: +1.8% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +5.3% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +4.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.4% over 3 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.6% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -1.4% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.6% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 77.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Dock Placement Guide Screen: Insert a new onboarding step after home intro showing visual guidance on taskbar anchoring and desktop pet controls. (why: Support receives frequent complaints about pets not showing up on desktop or users not knowing how to control or hide them after completing setup.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Companion Awakening Flow: Replace the static waiting screen with an active companion awakening sequence featuring animated progress and interactive tap responses. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off before onboarding finish.)
2: [sign_in, layout] Single-Click Identity Provider Layout: Change sign-in layout to compact format featuring visual provider buttons with clear security status text. (why: 8 support emails noted pets missing or reset due to duplicate or confused account sign-ins.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Shortcut Tray Hint: Display a permanent tray shortcut tip banner at the bottom of the home intro screen. (why: Users contact support post-onboarding complaining that it is unclear how to control, show, or hide their pet on desktop.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Path Selector Layout: Switch the choose path screen layout to spotlight mode to emphasize instant premade adoption versus custom photo generation. (why: 22.1% of users leave at path selection; visually contrasting the quick vs custom options helps swift decision making.)
5: [adoption, copy] Official Companion Name Certification Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to emphasize binding pet identity officially to user account storage. (why: Multiple support emails mention lost pets after signing in again; reinforcing identity binding builds awareness of account state.)
6: [finish, redesign] Interactive Companion Desktop Welcomer Redesign: Redesign home_intro to split layout featuring an interactive greeting mascot component to verify pet launch before finishing. (why: Finish stage drops 35.2% of users with an average duration over 5800s, suggesting users get stuck or leave before completion.)

scores.note: Finish step has high drop-off (35.2%) and strong support evidence, but adding a new screen historically showed negative results (-0.4%).
Home step has extreme wait times causing drop-off; interactive new flows on home have proven historically successful (+2.4% to +8.6%).
Sign-in loses 19% of users and support emails highlight duplicate sign-in confusion; layout updates generally perform well.
Finish stage drops 35.2% of users with clear support complaints; adding subtle hints has shown positive results across steps.
Choose path drops 22.1% of users; layout changes on choose_path previously delivered strong gains (+5.3%).
Adoption has high drop-off and support mail support, but copy changes consistently underperform or yield no clear effect.
Finish stage suffers heavy drop-off and long durations; full redesign has potential but incurs high implementation cost.
